pending-clause.answer: Read §2002:8.8.1.1 (order of evaluation and exponentiation exceptions, which apply 'regardless of the mode of arithmetic'), §2002:8.8.1.3.1 with §2002:8.8.1.3.1.1 ('with a precision of 32 decimal digits') and §2002:8.8.1.3.2 (each sum 'truncated to 32 significant digits'), and §2002:8.8.1.3.6 (exponentiation); this text governs only under ARITHMETIC IS STANDARD (§2002:8.8.1.3), and the compiler keeps 34 digits there at --std 2002 (PB5575, reconfirmed by probes-a-21/src/vals.cob: (B*100 + 1) - B*100 gives 1 where 2002 gives 0). Read §2002:15 and §2002:15.1: the function-definition list and the six function types are 2023's; 2002 15.1 adds the character-positions sentence for alphanumeric and national functions, which no rule here uses. AR5's default for an omitted argument-3 is NUMVAL(CURRENT-DATE(1:4)), a four-digit year (§2002:15.18.2 AR5); no user expression is evaluated. §2002:15.3.1 exempts DATE-TO-YYYYMMDD without argument-3 from the same-value rule, which agrees with a current-year default and changes nothing the witnesses show.
